name: Sister Maria no Momoiro Seika
original_name: シスターマリヤの桃色聖歌
source:
Following the untimely death of the church pastor, Maria endeavored to carryout the necessary tasks that would ensure her temple’s continued survival. Unfortunately, no matter her conviction and dedication, the required workload would always exceed the abilities of a single person. Thus Maria did what she always did in times of adversity: pray to the Lord for a miracle. In her heart, she knew her lowly appeal would finally be answered, but only if she believed in Him and herself.

[from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064855/www.elizar.com/?p=38]a review by Nargrakhan[/url]]
translation:
教会牧师英年早逝后，玛丽亚努力完成维持教堂运转所需的工作。然而，无论她多么虔诚、多么尽心尽力，任务量始终超出一人所能承担的范围。于是，玛丽亚在逆境中再次做出一贯的选择：向上帝祈求奇迹。她心里明白，自己卑微的请求终会得到回应，但前提是她必须相信上帝，也相信自己。

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064855/www.elizar.com/?p=38]Nargrakhan的评测[/url]]
